clue.text: Extremely in favour of record being made public

parts.note: extremely, as in highly or very much, gives high
pro means for, in favour of
a file is a record kept on someone

explanation.surface: Someone backs the release of an official record to the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being' is only a link between the wordplay and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prominent in the public eye has had plenty of exposure, so it has effectively been publicised.

clue.text: Robin left university — male thug

parts.note: Robin Hood, the outlaw of English legend

explanation.surface: A man called Robin quit university and turned violent.
explanation.definitionFit: A gangster or violent ruffian is a synonym for a brutal thug.

clue.text: Grand list of competitors, top-class people

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand pounds
the entry for a race or contest is the list of those taking part

explanation.surface: The roster for a grand event is full of upper-class participants.
explanation.definitionFit: The landed upper class, just below the nobility, is a synonym for well-born folk.

clue.text: A device signalling 'no visitors'? One's let down

definitions.text: A device signalling 'no visitors'? One's let down

parts.words: A device signalling 'no visitors'? One's let down
parts.note: a grille dropped over a castle gateway keeps callers out, and it is lowered when needed

explanation.surface: A host's way of hinting that guests are unwelcome disappoints someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let down' reads as disappointed, but it is literal: the heavy gate is lowered into place.
explanation.definitionFit: A castle gateway's heavy iron grille is dropped on chains to bar entry, a literal barrier to callers.

clue.text: Some touches that hurt!

indicators.note: some of the word touches means only part of its letters are taken

explanation.surface: A few gentle contacts turn out to be painful.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of sudden pain is what you say at a thing that hurt.

clue.text: Two thousand poems in Italian lacking propriety

indicators.note: in tells us the thousands and poems sit inside the abbreviation for Italian

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so two of them
odes are lyric poems

explanation.surface: An enormous collection of poems in Italian proves rather indecent.
explanation.definitionFit: Being boastful or indecent means behaving without decorum or modesty.

clue.text: Avoiding woman and son, I have to trail behind

parts.note: Eva is a woman's name
've is the contracted form of have

explanation.surface: Someone avoids a woman and her son by trailing well behind them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to trail behind' just says the pieces follow on in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodging or sidestepping is the sense of the adjective, as in taking action to escape something.

clue.text: Singer to boast endlessly, one getting little right

indicators.note: endlessly means the last letter of the word for boast is dropped

parts.note: to crow is to boast
taken as written
R is the short form, a little version, of right

explanation.surface: A vocalist brags constantly, while one of the group gets few rights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' cuts the final W from CROW, leaving CRO.
explanation.definitionFit: A vocalist who sings sentimental ballads softly, like Bing Crosby, is an example of a performer.

clue.text: Was obedient, keeping pet in — not straightforward

indicators.note: keeping means the word for obedient holds the pet within it

parts.note: complied means did as asked, was obedient
a cat is a household pet

explanation.surface: Someone did as told and kept their pet indoors, though it was tricky.
explanation.definitionFit: Intricate or involved is a synonym of not simple, the opposite of plain and direct.

clue.text: Come kitted out with lab instrument

indicators.note: kitted out suggests the letters of come and lab are dressed up in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone arrives equipped with laboratory gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A harpsichord, the keyboard of baroque music, is another name for this musical device.

clue.text: Neither here nor there? Quite the opposite!

definitions.text: Neither here nor there? Quite the opposite!

parts.words: Neither here nor there? Quite the opposite!
parts.note: the reverse of being in neither place is being in both places, and everywhere else too

explanation.surface: A remark is dismissed as irrelevant, then the speaker insists on the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Neither here nor there' looks like the idiom for irrelevant, but read literally it means absent from both places; its opposite is present everywhere.
explanation.definitionFit: Being everywhere at once is the sense, a quality ascribed to God.

clue.text: Flow of water in motorway bad — hurry!

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1
ill means bad, as in ill effects
to race is to hurry

explanation.surface: Flooding on a motorway is bad, so drivers rush through.
explanation.definitionFit: The channel carrying a stream to turn a mill wheel is a current of water.

clue.text: A doctor favoured hugging a man

indicators.note: hugging means the word for favoured wraps round the second a

parts.note: in means fashionable, favoured

explanation.surface: A popular physician embraces a fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy's name, borne by the Roman emperor Hadrian's namesakes, is an example of a male person.

clue.text: New frontiers established across a wooded area

indicators.note: established across means the rearranged letters are set up straddling the single a
new means the letters of frontiers are made over afresh

explanation.surface: Fresh borders are drawn through a forested region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges FRONTIERS into RINFOREST, and 'established across' sets it around A.
explanation.definitionFit: A dense tropical jungle with high rainfall is an example of woodland.

clue.text: Losing sides blamed — not convincing

indicators.note: losing sides means the word blamed drops its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Those blamed for losing a match are unconvincing.
explanation.definitionFit: A weak or feeble excuse is described with this adjective, meaning unpersuasive.

clue.text: What overwhelming winner makes — man destined to get black marks?

definitions.meaning: a whitewash, winning every game or prize available

definitions.text: man destined to get black marks?
definitions.meaning: a chimney cleaner who is spotless now will soon be covered in soot

explanation.surface: A dominant champion and a man doomed to be marked in black.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is whimsical: a soot-free chimney cleaner is bound to get sooty.
explanation.definitionFit: A total victory taking everything is the first sense; the second is a literal spotless chimney cleaner.

clue.text: One snake being hugged by girl? People scattered!

indicators.note: being hugged by means the one and the snake sit inside the girl's name

parts.note: Dora is a girl's name
I is the Roman numeral for one
an asp is a venomous snake

explanation.surface: A girl embraces a snake, and everyone flees!
explanation.definitionFit: The dispersal of a people, notably the Jews, from their homeland is the sense of a scattered community.

clue.text: Not social, I ruined alliances

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of not social and I are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: An unsociable person admits to having wrecked partnerships.
explanation.definitionFit: Unions of parties forming a government together are synonyms for pacts.

clue.text: Excellent bishop to give support to attack

parts.note: A1 means first-rate; the 1 is read as the letter I
RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
to aid is to give support

explanation.surface: A fine bishop is asked to back an offensive.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombing raid by aircraft is an example of an assault.

clue.text: River in super area

indicators.note: in means the river's abbreviation is placed inside the word for super

parts.note: ace is slang for super, excellent

explanation.surface: A river runs through a splendid region.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of land measurement, 4,840 square yards, is a measure of extent.

clue.text: Greek character meeting thin south American

parts.note: chi is the 22nd letter of the Greek alphabet
lean means thin

explanation.surface: A Greek meets a slim visitor from South America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meeting' is a link joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Chile, on the continent's west coast, is a South American national.

clue.text: Platform politician's first to take blame

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of politician's is taken

parts.note: odium is hatred or blame attached to someone

explanation.surface: A politician steps up first to accept responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: A raised stand for a speaker or winners is a kind of dais.

clue.text: Beat Henry in scraps

indicators.note: in means the abbreviation for Henry goes inside the word for scraps

parts.note: trash is waste, scraps
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Henry beats someone during fights.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scraps' looks like fights, but it is rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash is to flog or to defeat soundly, both senses of the verb.

clue.text: Party — see little kid rock!

parts.note: a do is a party
lo is an old word meaning look, see
a mite is a small child

explanation.surface: At a party, look at that small child rocking out!
explanation.definitionFit: A carbonate mineral forming mountains in northern Italy is a type of sedimentary stone.

clue.text: Catch horse by entrance to stable

indicators.note: entrance to means the first letter of stable, its opening

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

explanation.surface: Grab the horse at the stable door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just places the horse next to the letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidden drawback or problem is the noun sense, like a catch in a deal.

clue.text: Compel ferocious woman to admit love

indicators.note: to admit means to let in, so the fierce woman takes in the letter for love

parts.note: a dragon is a fierce, formidable woman
O is love, a score of nil in tennis

explanation.surface: Pressure a fierce woman into confessing her love.
explanation.definitionFit: To force or coerce someone into doing something is the verb's sense.

clue.text: Plain little girl in garden getting tense

indicators.note: in means the little girl's name goes inside the garden

parts.note: Eden is the biblical garden
Vi is a short name for a girl such as Violet
T is the abbreviation for tense in grammar

explanation.surface: A plain little girl in a garden grows anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plain' looks like an adjective for the girl, but it is the definition, meaning obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Obvious or clear to see is the sense of plain here.

clue.text: Game fellow who draws up plans?

parts.note: draughts is the board game known in the US as checkers
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: A sporting chap who designs blueprints.
explanation.walkthrough: DRAUGHTS is the British name for checkers.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who produces technical drawings of buildings or machines is a draftsman.
